type.primary: IBM Plex Mono 400/500, font-feature-settings tnum and zero
type.svg_font_stack: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace
type.note: SVG text nodes use the font stack above; the site loads Plex Mono so inline SVGs render with it. Self hosted woff2 files are in fonts/.

icon_spec.fills: none except the kept cell in candidate.svg and log.svg
icon_spec.note: stroke 1.5px per art_direction_spec section 16; the orchestrator's brief said 1.25px, the spec value was kept so QA reads one number
icon_spec.animates: icons appear Stepped with their row; no draw on, no hover colour (the accent is never an icon colour)

survivors.seed: FNV 1a 32 of "run 04:12" = 3776823747, mulberry32, Fisher Yates shuffle of indices 0..47
survivors.rule: shuffled order: first 17 die at gate 1 point in time, next 17 at gate 3 costs, next 8 at gate 4 capacity, last 6 kept; gate 2 walk forward kills none
survivors.index_convention: row major on the 8 column grid, index = row * 8 + col, trial id = index + 1
survivors.note: the builder hardcodes gate_of_index so the lattice, the DOM trial grid, the seal and the cell rule agree

motion.reduced_motion: no cell by cell fills, no draws; every asset renders in its final state at once; the seal and grids are static; the cursor does not blink

items.appears: lattice cell, DOM trial grid, loader gauge, favicon unit, seal unit; every unrun cell on the site
items.animates: outline appears Stepped (no fade); the fill state Latches in 120ms when the cell is run

items.appears: trial grid, lattice, seal, cell rule, loader after a gate
items.animates: fill Latches in 120ms, arriving 40ms after the previous cell in gate order

items.role: motif, kept state (accent fill; one of the three permitted accent uses)
items.appears: the six survivors in every grid, the KEPT icons
items.animates: Settle over 360ms, always last in the sequence

items.role: motif, live state (grey 3 outline; the loader gauge and the lattice rim before the cull)
items.appears: loader gauge, lattice cells before a gate
items.animates: outline appears Stepped as real load advances; rim breathes on a 6s sine in the lattice only

items.appears: About closing block, order confirmation beside DONE, footer, favicon source
items.animates: cells fill one at a time in gate order (point in time 17, walk forward 0, costs 17, capacity 8) at 40ms, the six survivors Settle last over 360ms, then the fraction and wordmark appear Stepped; the .seal-grid group carries data-cadence-ms and data-order
all 48 cells fill grey at 40ms; nothing turns green

items.role: favicon, 16 by 12 reduction of the seal at 2px cells on a 16 by 16 ground
divider 1, the gate rule (hairline broken by a labelled 2ch gap; swap the label text per section: 01 · the run, 02 · the log, 03 · the candidate)
items.animates: the two hairlines draw to full width with Settle over 900ms from the label outward; label appears Stepped

items.role: divider 2, the cell rule (48 cells at 4px, 42 grey and 6 kept in the seal positions)
items.appears: before footers, between blog post sections
items.animates: cells fill left to right at 40ms in gate order; survivors last

items.role: divider 3, the prompt rule (prompt glyph then a hairline to the right margin)
items.appears: above frames, above the Plans cards
items.animates: glyph slides in 1ch with Latch over 120ms, hairline draws right with Settle over 900ms

items.role: oversized numeral treatment reference ($310M, unit welded, label beneath); the builder reproduces it in DOM type, this file is the visual spec
items.appears: stats strip on Home and /sweep, plan prices, the Fraction
items.animates: digits step vertically one slot per 120ms with Latch (odometer clip, never a roll); the numerator turns accent only at its final value

items.role: texture, tiling 12px cell field in hairline colour at 40 percent opacity (art direction section 16)
items.appears: behind the frames of About and the legal pages, as a repeating background-image

items.role: equity curve for candidate id 34 (in sample grey 2, walk forward accent, 1px, no fill, no markers)
items.appears: inside frame C at 64px height, alone at 120px on Plans and the blog
items.animates: draws left to right once over 600ms, then holds (stroke-dasharray reveal or clip path)

items.role: the DOM trial grid reference, 48 cells with gate legend, positions seeded from run 04:12
items.appears: inside frame B above the rows, the mobile hero, the /sweep empty state (as outlines)
items.animates: cells fill in gate order at 40ms apart; each cell carries data-trial, data-gate and a title for the mono tooltip

icons.meaning: the candidate, the survivor (the one icon with a fill)
a run, a log line arriving (orchestrator addition)
a seat on a plan (orchestrator addition)
